title: Boys Playing Outdoor Volleyball Game, 1957 Summer Snapshot Photo
description: An elevated view captures a lively outdoor volleyball match underway on a spacious grassy field, with a net strung between two wooden posts. Several young players in light summer attire participate while others stand in position across both sides of the court. In the background, tall deciduous trees shade a large pavilion or institutional hall. The front margin is stamped 'JUL • 57' and hand-labeled 'Volley Ball Game', capturing a slice of mid-century American recreational life.
